verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these four kinds of grasping.
Grasping at sensual pleasures, views, precepts and observances, and theories of a self.
These are the four kinds of grasping.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṁ upādānānaṁ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …pe… ayaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
verses.english: The noble eightfold path should be developed for the direct knowledge, complete understanding, finishing, and giving up of these four kinds of grasping.”
